criterion: The host states the purpose of the photo activity.
rationale: People can make a better choice when the intended ritual and audience are explicit.
evidence_prompt: Record the invitation or opening explanation.

criterion: Participation is optional and refusal has no penalty.
rationale: Group pressure can undermine a nominal choice.
evidence_prompt: Document the non-participation path and host wording.

criterion: The group knows which device will capture and store photos.
rationale: A shared phone concentrates custody and access in one place.
evidence_prompt: Identify the device owner and who can unlock it.

criterion: The reveal time and audience are stated in advance.
rationale: Delayed capture should not hide when or with whom images will be viewed.
evidence_prompt: Record the timer and planned audience.

criterion: Rules for minors and guardians are explicit.
rationale: Age and safeguarding requirements need a separate decision, not an assumption.
evidence_prompt: Record the age rule and guardian process.

criterion: The device gives a clear indication when a photo is taken.
rationale: A blind preview should not become covert capture.
evidence_prompt: Observe shutter feedback, screen state and sound behavior.

criterion: A person can decline a specific photo after joining the activity.
rationale: Joining once should not remove control over later moments.
evidence_prompt: Demonstrate how a participant signals no capture.

criterion: Sensitive spaces and situations are excluded.
rationale: Bathrooms, changing areas, distress and incapacity require firm boundaries.
evidence_prompt: Inspect host rules and in-product safety guidance.

criterion: The product does not imply that hidden preview prevents misuse.
rationale: A concealed preview cannot stop another camera, coercion or later screenshots.
evidence_prompt: Review claims about privacy and secrecy.

criterion: The group renews consent before the shared reveal.
rationale: Circumstances may change between capture and viewing.
evidence_prompt: Record the prompt or host check immediately before reveal.

criterion: The reveal can be paused or stopped.
rationale: A participant needs an immediate control if an image causes concern.
evidence_prompt: Demonstrate pause, exit and device-lock behavior.

criterion: An unwanted image has a deletion path.
rationale: Delayed surprise should not override removal after viewing.
evidence_prompt: Test deletion before any save or export.

criterion: Screenshot and screen-recording limits are disclosed.
rationale: Software may not be able to detect or prevent secondary capture.
evidence_prompt: Check the notice and test operating-system capture.

criterion: Saving a photo is a separate action from revealing it.
rationale: Viewing within an app should not silently create another library copy.
evidence_prompt: Compare app storage before and after reveal and save.

criterion: Save and share actions state their destination.
rationale: Copies can move beyond the original group and retention rules.
evidence_prompt: Record the permission prompt, destination and share sheet.

criterion: Participants agree before public posting or redistribution.
rationale: Consent to capture is not automatically consent to publication.
evidence_prompt: Document the approval process for each external audience.

criterion: Local, cloud and backup storage are distinguished.
rationale: A claim of local storage can coexist with device-level backup or export.
evidence_prompt: Map app storage, system backup and any service upload.

criterion: Retention and capsule deletion are explained.
rationale: Users need to know whether opening, saving or uninstalling changes the original.
evidence_prompt: Test opening, manual deletion and uninstall behavior.

criterion: Permissions are limited to the selected function.
rationale: Camera, microphone and photo-library access have different consequences.
evidence_prompt: Record each permission, timing and fallback when denied.

criterion: The device lock and account boundary are part of the threat model.
rationale: Local content remains exposed if the shared device itself is accessible.
evidence_prompt: Document screen-lock, app-lock and guest-access behavior.

criterion: There is a visible reporting and urgent-removal route.
rationale: People need a path for harmful, unlawful or child-safety content.
evidence_prompt: Verify the public contact and response instructions.

criterion: Privacy and enjoyment claims are bounded and testable.
rationale: A product feature does not prove safety, consent quality or a better social outcome.
evidence_prompt: Classify each claim and record the evidence and limitations.
